summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, presented in both US dollars and Argentine pesos. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, containing standard financial disclosures such as balance sheet, income statement, and notes. No special-situation event (merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is indicated. The content is purely financial reporting with no transactional terms, advisors, or board recommendations. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
